cohort: 3,737 pregnant women with psoriasis and 13,792,544 pregnant women without psoriasis
finding: Pregnant women with psoriasis were more likely to experience adverse pregnancy outcomes, including preeclampsia, gestational diabetes, and cesarean section, while their newborns were at higher risk of preterm birth, congenital anomalies, and intra-uterine growth restriction.
mod_finding: Women with psoriasis were more likely to deliver by cesarean section (OR 1.2, 95% CI 1.1-1.3).
